audit_subject: CARL-DX Wall & Obstacle Approach Forensic Reconstruction Report

t_1_37s_to_4_00s_ticks_42_to_120.behavior: Obstacle Proximity Hugging / Stall without Steering Evasion
t_1_37s_to_4_00s_ticks_42_to_120.obstacle_contact_zone: Arena dynamic prop / hazard cube at (0.75, 0.18)
t_1_37s_to_4_00s_ticks_42_to_120.assessment: FAILURE OF ANTICIPATORY AVOIDANCE. The agent pushed forward against the obstacle for ~78 ticks (2.6s) without executing a turn away.

t_4_00s_to_5_00s_ticks_121_to_150.behavior: Passive Braking instead of Active Steering
t_4_00s_to_5_00s_ticks_121_to_150.assessment: Agent halted passively at the obstacle instead of generating an anticipatory steering maneuver to maintain clearance.

dreamer_rollout_defect.issue: Dreamer simulated candidate trajectory risk using hardcoded boundary check (abs(x) > 4.5) rather than integrating actual sensed rangefinder / sonar obstacle distance profiles.

action_veto_disconnect.issue: Operational action veto checked only external command magnitude, but did not assert internal veto when self-generated STRAIGHT_FORWARD violated forward sonar clearance.

safety_margin_decoupling.issue: Collapsed safety margin (0.45) modified only affect posture (THREAT_AVERSION) but exerted zero direct penalty on straight forward motor selection in Dreamer.
